name: The Escaping Mistress
overview: After discovering that their husbands are both having affairs, wealthy Ann Kane and hardworking Joan Sands form an unlikely alliance to save their marriages. Believing the women involved are different, they devise separate plans—only to uncover the shocking truth that both men are involved with the same mysterious woman, Sandra. As betrayal, deception, and unexpected revelations unravel their lives, Ann and Joan must decide whether to fight for their marriages or reclaim their own happiness.
